showtimewomen.us.title: Sweetness
showtimewomen.us.description: When a superfan learns that her rock-star idol is spiraling into addiction, she makes it her mission to save him, whether he wants her help or not. However, when her desperate plan spins out of control, she kidnaps him in a delusional attempt to fix him. What started as compassion soon turns into captivity as she locks him away in the name of love. (Thriller) - 2025

showtimewomen.us.title: Blindness
showtimewomen.us.description: When an epidemic of a disease known as the "white sickness" appears in her city, the wife (Julianne Moore) of a doctor is one of the few individuals left who still has sight. Sent to a government asylum along with her now-blind husband (Mark Ruffalo), she sees conditions deteriorate until civilization itself is in jeopardy, prompting her break-out of the asylum to lead a small group to freedom. (Thriller, Drama) - 2008

showtimewomen.us.title: The Ruins
showtimewomen.us.description: Amy (Jena Malone), Stacy (Laura Ramsey), Jeff (Jonathan Tucker) and Eric (Shawn Ashmore) look for fun during a sunny holiday in Mexico, but they get much more than that after visiting an archaeological dig in the jungle. Carnivorous vines try to ensnare the friends in their tendrils, forcing the group to fight for survival. (Horror, Thriller, Adventure, Action, Mystery) - 2008

showtimewomen.us.title: Lara Croft Tomb Raider: The Cradle of Life
showtimewomen.us.description: Fearless explorer Lara Croft (Angelina Jolie) tries to locate Pandora's box before criminals Jonathan Reiss (Ciarán Hinds) and Chen Lo (Simon Yam) use it for evil. According to myth, the box holds deadly organisms that could kill millions of people. With her old partner, Terry (Gerard Butler), Croft goes on a hunt that takes her from Europe to Asia to Africa, where pal Kosa (Djimon Hounsou) helps her. Along the way, Croft rappels down cliffs, scuba dives and decimates many male opponents. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Thriller) - 2003

showtimewomen.us.title: The Haunting
showtimewomen.us.description: This horror tale focuses on visitors to the secluded mansion of Hill House who have been called to the isolated location by Dr. David Marrow (Liam Neeson) as part of a study on insomnia. However, Marrow is really investigating fear, and he plans to scare the subjects, including the introverted Nell (Lili Taylor) and the seductive Theo (Catherine Zeta-Jones). Unfortunately for Marrow and everyone staying at Hill House, the manor is actually haunted by an evil spirit out to torment its guests. (Horror, Thriller, Fantasy, Mystery) - 1999

showtimewomen.us.title: The Ring
showtimewomen.us.description: It sounds like just another urban legend -- a videotape filled with nightmarish images leads to a phone call foretelling the viewer's death in exactly seven days. Newspaper reporter Rachel Keller (Naomi Watts) is skeptical of the story until four teenagers all die mysteriously exactly one week after watching just such a tape. Allowing her investigative curiosity to get the better of her, Rachel tracks down the video and watches it. Now she has just seven days to unravel the mystery. (Horror, Thriller, Mystery) - 2002

showtimewomen.us.title: Paranormal Activity 2
showtimewomen.us.description: When the Reys move into their new Southern California home, little do they realize that the house is already occupied. After coming home one day to find the house in disarray -- but with no signs of forced entry or robbery -- they install a video surveillance system to catch the perpetrators. But nothing prepares them for what happens next. (Horror, Thriller) - 2010

showtimewomen.us.title: Molly's Game
showtimewomen.us.description: The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe. (Biography, Drama) - 2017

showtimewomen.us.title: The Gift
showtimewomen.us.description: In the tiny town of Brixton, Georgia where nothing is private, a woman with supernatural clairvoyance, a young beautiful socialite who has mysteriously disappeared, and an assortment of colorful characters all collide. A haunting psychological thriller, "The Gift" is ultimately a profound celebration of the human spirit. (Thriller, Mystery) - 2000

showtimewomen.us.title: You're Dating a Narcissist!
showtimewomen.us.description: A psychology professor who has a knack for spotting narcissists flies across the country to prove that the man her daughter is marrying is a fraud. (Romantic comedy) - 2025

showtimewomen.us.title: Bridget Jones's Diary
showtimewomen.us.description: At the start of the New Year, 32-year-old Bridget (Renée Zellweger) decides it's time to take control of her life -- and start keeping a diary. Now, the most provocative, erotic and hysterical book on her bedside table is the one she's writing. With a taste for adventure, and an opinion on every subject - from exercise to men to food to sex and everything in between - she's turning the page on a whole new life. (Romantic comedy) - 2001

showtimewomen.us.title: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason
showtimewomen.us.description: The sequel to "Bridget Jones's Diary" finds Bridget (Renée Zellweger) working as a TV host and still dating barrister Mark (Colin Firth). But Bridget is jealous of the time Mark spends with a co-worker (Jacinda Barrett), and, despite a vacation meant to smooth things over, ends their relationship. On assignment in Thailand, she has a dalliance with her disreputable ex, Daniel (Hugh Grant), and is temporarily jailed on the false accusation of drug smuggling, before Mark comes to the rescue. (Romantic comedy) - 2004

showtimewomen.us.title: The Intern
showtimewomen.us.description: Starting a new job can be a difficult challenge, especially if you're already retired. Looking to get back into the game, 70-year-old widower Ben Whittaker seizes the opportunity to become a senior intern at an online fashion site. Ben soon becomes popular with his younger co-workers, including Jules Ostin, the boss and founder of the company. Whittaker's charm, wisdom and sense of humor help him develop a special bond and growing friendship with Jules. (Comedy drama) - 2015

showtimewomen.us.title: What Women Want
showtimewomen.us.description: A freak accident gives a Chicago advertising executive (Mel Gibson) the ability to read women's minds. - 2000

screenpixaction.us.title: The Masque of the Red Death
screenpixaction.us.description: A tyrannical 12th-century prince is intrigued by a girl and takes her to live amid the immorality of his court. (Horror) - 1964

screenpixaction.us.title: The Fall of the House of Usher
screenpixaction.us.description: Based on the classic story "The Fall of the House of Usher" by Edgar Allan Poe and directed by legendary filmmaker Roger Corman, this thriller features Vincent Price as Roderick Usher, a man who believes his family to be cursed by incurable madness. So sure is he of his family's doom, that when his sister Madeline (Myrna Fahey) announces her engagement to Philip Winthrop (Mark Damon), Roderick will stop at nothing to prevent their marriage and keep the Usher bloodline from continuing. (Horror) - 1960

screenpixaction.us.title: The Oblong Box
screenpixaction.us.description: Julian (Vincent Price) hides his horrendously disfigured brother, Sir Edward Markham (Alister Williamson), in a tower where he is kept in chains. Anxious for freedom, Edward fakes his death with the aid of an immoral attorney, Trench (Peter Arne), and a pill that puts him into a catatonic state. But the escape plan takes a treacherous turn when Julian unwittingly buries his brother alive -- and he's later unearthed by grave robbers under the employ of malevolent Dr. Neuhardt (Christopher Lee). (Horror) - 1969

screenpixaction.us.title: The Gravedancers
screenpixaction.us.description: After a funeral, several college friends reunite in a cemetery and reminisce about the former life of the deceased. The celebration starts to go too far after they get drunk and begin dancing on graves, and as a result, each of them becomes haunted by malevolent spirits. (Horror, Thriller) - 2006

screenpixaction.us.title: Diary of a Madman
screenpixaction.us.description: When Judge Simon Cordier (Vincent Price) goes to see Louis Girot (Harvey Stephens), a prisoner he sentenced to death, the criminal insists he is not guilty and that he is inhabited by an evil spirit. Cordier dismisses Girot's claims, but he becomes unnerved when Girot lights himself on fire to supposedly end the demonic possession. After the visit, Cordier, beset by insomnia, begins to have odd visions and starts to wonder if Girot might have been telling the truth after all. (Horror) - 1963

screenpixaction.us.title: Crime of Passion
screenpixaction.us.description: When newspaper columnist Kathy Ferguson (Barbara Stanwyck) meets cop Bill Doyle (Sterling Hayden), the two quickly hit it off and get married. Kathy gives up her career and heads to Los Angeles with Bill to settle down. The homemaker lifestyle doesn't suit Kathy, however, and she becomes bored with her life and resentful toward Bill because he doesn't share her drive for success. She then secretly decides to make major moves to further Bill's career -- even if it means murdering his rivals. (Crime drama) - 1957

screenpixaction.us.title: The Woman in the Window
screenpixaction.us.description: With his family packed off to Maine, Professor Richard Wanley is anticipating some quiet time alone. Then he meets Alice, the model for a portrait he admires, and can't resist her offer of a drink. No sooner do they get to her place, however, than her jealous boyfriend arrives in a rage. Richard kills him in self-defense, and they decide to hide the body. Things go smoothly until Richard's D.A. friend invites him to tag along on the investigation of his own crime. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1944

screenpixaction.us.title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
screenpixaction.us.description: Sherlock Holmes (Peter Cushing) and Doctor Watson (Andre Morell) meet with a certain Dr. Mortimer (Francis De Wolff), who tells them of the legend of the "hound," born out of a murder committed by Sir Hugo Baskerville centuries ago. Explaining that Sir Charles Baskerville recently died in the same location as Sir Hugo, Mortimer expresses his deep concern that Sir Henry, the heir to the Baskerville estate, will also fall prey to the evil hound's curse. Holmes sets out to investigate. (Mystery, Horror) - 1959

screenpixaction.us.title: The Pit and the Pendulum
screenpixaction.us.description: Elizabeth Barnard Medina (Barbara Steele) has died in the prime of life, and her brother, Francis (John Kerr), wants to know why. Elizabeth's husband, Nicholas (Vincent Price), and her doctor offer differing explanations, but when Francis learns that Nicholas' mother may have been buried alive, he begins to wonder if his sister met the same fate. And when he comes to believe that Elizabeth's spirit wanders about Nicholas' castle, Francis investigates -- and is stunned by what he finds. (Horror) - 1961

screenpixaction.us.title: Tower of London
screenpixaction.us.description: In 15th-century England, Richard III (Vincent Price) desperately wants the throne, but his ailing brother, King Edward IV (Justice Watson), instead bestows it upon his other sibling, Clarence (Richard McCauly). This sends Richard into a homicidal rage, resulting in Clarence's murder and the deaths and torture of many others who could keep the crown from the crazed man. But as the mayhem continues, Richard's sanity slips, and the ghosts of the murdered men begin to haunt the beleaguered royal. (Horror) - 1962

screenpixaction.us.title: The Masque of the Red Death
screenpixaction.us.description: A tyrannical 12th-century prince is intrigued by a girl and takes her to live amid the immorality of his court. (Horror) - 1964

screenpixaction.us.title: The Fall of the House of Usher
screenpixaction.us.description: Based on the classic story "The Fall of the House of Usher" by Edgar Allan Poe and directed by legendary filmmaker Roger Corman, this thriller features Vincent Price as Roderick Usher, a man who believes his family to be cursed by incurable madness. So sure is he of his family's doom, that when his sister Madeline (Myrna Fahey) announces her engagement to Philip Winthrop (Mark Damon), Roderick will stop at nothing to prevent their marriage and keep the Usher bloodline from continuing. (Horror) - 1960

screenpixaction.us.title: The Oblong Box
screenpixaction.us.description: Julian (Vincent Price) hides his horrendously disfigured brother, Sir Edward Markham (Alister Williamson), in a tower where he is kept in chains. Anxious for freedom, Edward fakes his death with the aid of an immoral attorney, Trench (Peter Arne), and a pill that puts him into a catatonic state. But the escape plan takes a treacherous turn when Julian unwittingly buries his brother alive -- and he's later unearthed by grave robbers under the employ of malevolent Dr. Neuhardt (Christopher Lee). (Horror) - 1969

Intent on replacing the lodge with an enormous resort, Maris schemes to get Pops' lease revoked. What he doesn't count on is the mountain's madcap ski patrol. As the crazed crew leaps into action to save Pops' business, Maris begins to wish he'd never thought of building his eyesore on their winter playground. (Comedy) - 1990

screenpix.us.title: The Group
screenpix.us.description: Eight young women from the Vassar College class of 1933 rush out into the world to find exciting lives, but discover nothing is quite as they dreamed. Kay Strong, the center of the group, gradually loses faith in the promise of their lives and, as war approaches, becomes unhinged. (Drama, LGBTQ) - 1966

screenpix.us.title: Greyfriars Bobby
screenpix.us.description: When his owner, police officer John Gray (Thomas Lockyer), is killed in the line of duty, Bobby, a particularly faithful West Highland terrier, takes up residence in the graveyard where Gray was interred. Bobby charms everyone he meets, and the canine's continued exploits make him a legend among the local working poor. When oppressive factory owner Smithie (Sean Pertwee) plots to kill Bobby, Gray's impoverished young ward, Ewan (Oliver Golding), must protect him from a ruthless dogcatcher. (Drama) - 2005

screenpix.us.title: Something Wild
screenpix.us.description: When college girl Mary Ann Robinson (Carroll Baker) is attacked and raped, her world is shattered. Unable to carry on a normal routine with her critical mother, Mary Ann takes a room in a New York City hovel and accepts a job at a dime store as she struggles to come to grips with her ordeal. Sinking into isolation, she attempts suicide and is saved by a concerned bystander, lonely auto mechanic Mike (Ralph Meeker). showtime2west.us.description: When a man claiming to be Fester, the missing brother of Gomez Addams, arrives at the Addams' home, the family is thrilled. Morticia begins to suspect the man is a fraud, since he cannot recall details of Fester's life.

showtimefamily.us.title: Regarding Henry
showtimefamily.us.description: Two bullets force a career-driven Manhattan lawyer (Harrison Ford) to start life over with his loving wife (Annette Bening) and daughter.

showtimefamily.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark
showtimefamily.us.description: Globe-trotting archaeologist Indiana Jones races the Nazis for possession of a legendary religious artifact.

showtimefamily.us.title: Our Ghosts
showtimefamily.us.description: Hiding in the attic of his former apartment, a widowed and jobless father tries to scare the new tenant so he can live there once again.

showtimefamily.us.title: Three Wishes
showtimefamily.us.description: A frustrated family man recalls an encounter he (Joseph Mazzello), his widowed mom (Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio) and his family had with a mysterious vagrant (Patrick Swayze) in 1955 suburbia.

showtimefamily.us.title: The Wild Thornberrys Movie
showtimefamily.us.description: Eliza (Lacey Chabert), who communicates with animals, tries to stop deadly poachers with the help of a chimp, Darwin (Tom Kane).

showtimefamily.us.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture
showtimefamily.us.description: Adm. Kirk (William Shatner), Mr. Spock (Leonard Nimoy), Dr. McCoy (DeForest Kelley) and crew embark in the overhauled Enterprise to find an intelligent entity called VGER.

showtimefamily.us.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
showtimefamily.us.description: A renegade Vulcan makes Kirk (William Shatner), Spock (Leonard Nimoy), McCoy (DeForest Kelley) and the Enterprise go to a planet at the center of the galaxy.

showtimefamily.us.title: Star Trek Generations
showtimefamily.us.description: Capt. Kirk (William Shatner) and Capt. Picard (Patrick Stewart) team up to thwart mad Dr. Soran's (Malcolm McDowell) quest for the Nexus of joy.

showtimefamily.us.title: The Real Charlie Chaplin
showtimefamily.us.description: Combining unheard audio recordings, dramatic reconstructions and personal archives, filmmakers Peter Middleton and James Spinney trace Charlie Chaplin's meteoric rise from the slums of Victorian London to the heights of Hollywood superstardom.

showtimefamily.us.title: The House of Mirth
showtimefamily.us.description: In the early 20th century, a socialite (Gillian Anderson) cannot decide between marrying for wealth and status or marrying the man (Eric Stoltz) she loves.

showtimefamily.us.title: The Wedding Singer
showtimefamily.us.description: A wedding singer loses all hope when he is abandoned at the altar by his fiancée. He meets a young woman named Julia, who enlists his help to plan her wedding. He falls in love with her and must win her over before she gets married.

showtimefamily.us.title: Top Gun
showtimefamily.us.description: For Lieutenant Pete "Maverick" Mitchell and his friend and co-pilot Nick "Goose" Bradshaw, being accepted into an elite training school for fighter pilots is a dream come true. But a tragedy will threaten Pete's dreams of becoming an ace pilot.

showtimefamily.us.title: Forrest Gump
showtimefamily.us.description: JFK, LBJ, Vietnam, Watergate and other history unfold through the perspective of an Alabama man (Tom Hanks) with an IQ of 75.

showtimenext.us.title: Doin' It
showtimenext.us.description: Moonlighting as a high-school substitute teacher, a 30-year-old virgin gets in over her head when she's assigned to teach sex education. (Comedy) - 2024

showtimenext.us.title: Love Me
showtimenext.us.description: A buoy and a satellite meet online long after humanity's extinction. As they learn what life was like on Earth, they discover themselves and what it means to be alive and in love. (Romance, Science fiction, Drama) - 2024

showtimenext.us.title: Regarding Us
showtimenext.us.description: After losing her teaching career in the Catholic school system, a transgender woman has a profound impact on the lives of two children, one with two fathers in marital strife, and the other a recent transplant from a conservative household. When the children form a unique bond, new questions and old prejudices erupt. (Drama, Comedy) - 2025

showtimenext.us.title: The Wedding Banquet
showtimenext.us.description: Hoping to stay in the country, a gay man proposes a green card marriage to a female friend in exchange for paying for her IVF treatment. However, things soon get complicated when his grandmother surprises them with plans for an extravagant Korean wedding banquet. (Romantic comedy, LGBTQ) - 2025

showtimenext.us.title: Kevin Garnett: Anything Is Possible
showtimenext.us.description: Chronicling the career of one of the NBA's all-time greats, featuring scenes from Garnett's induction into the Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame. (Special, Documentary, Basketball) - 2021-11-12

showtimenext.us.title: Dean
showtimenext.us.description: An illustrator falls in love with a woman while trying to keep his father from burning down the family home after his wife dies. (Comedy drama) - 2016

showtimenext.us.title: Just Another Immigrant: Romesh at the Greek
showtimenext.us.description: Romesh Ranganathan, a successful comedian in England, moves his entire family to Los Angeles to make it as a comedian in America; he then takes the drastic step of performing his first ever U.S. stand-up show at the historic Greek Theatre. (Special, Comedy, Standup) - 2018-07-27

showtimenext.us.title: Queen of the Desert
showtimenext.us.description: Gertrude Bell's life as an explorer, cartographer, and archaeologist for the British Empire. (Biography, Historical drama) - 2015

showtimenext.us.title: I, Daniel Blake
showtimenext.us.description: Daniel Blake (Dave Johns) is a 59-year-old widowed carpenter who must rely on welfare after a recent heart attack leaves him unable to work. Despite his doctor's diagnosis, British authorities deny Blake's benefits and tell him to return to his job. As Daniel navigates his way through an agonizing appeal process, he begins to develop a strong bond with a destitute, single mother (Hayley Squires) who's struggling to take care of her two children. (Drama) - 2016

showtimenext.us.title: Wakefield
showtimenext.us.description: Howard Wakefield, a New York City lawyer, hides out in the attic of his home for weeks, coming out in the daytime when his family is gone to shower and eat. His withdrawal leads him to examine his life, and he rationalizes that he has not abandoned his family because he is still in the house. When a former boyfriend re-enters his wife's life, he realizes that he may not be able to return to life he has abandoned. (Drama) - 2016

showtimenext.us.title: We're the Millers
showtimenext.us.description: Small-time pot dealer David learns the hard way that no good deed goes unpunished; trying to help some teens, he is jumped by thugs and loses his cash and stash. Now, David's in big debt to his supplier and to wipe the slate clean, he must go to Mexico to pick up the guy's latest shipment. To accomplish his mission, Dave devises a foolproof plan: He packs a fake family into a huge RV and heads south of the border for a wild weekend that is sure to end with a bang. (Comedy, Action, Crime drama) - 2013

showtimenext.us.title: Black Lotus
showtimenext.us.description: A soldier uses his military training to rescue the kidnapped daughter of his dead friend. (Action, Thriller) - 2023

showtimenext.us.title: Wes Craven Presents: They
showtimenext.us.description: Julia (Laura Regan), a smart, athletic psychology student is finally starting to get her life together. As a kid she was traumatized by night terrors, but now she is cruising towards a successful career as a psychologist and has a rock solid EMT boyfriend to boot (Marc Blucas). After a friend commits suicide - saying the night terrors have returned - Julia and some of her other friends start to experience the same terrors... (Horror, Thriller) - 2002

showtimenext.us.title: Scream 4
showtimenext.us.description: It has been many years since the Ghostface Killer cut a deadly path through the town of Woodsboro. In order to get over the trauma of those horrific events, Sidney Prescott (Neve Campbell) has written a self-help book. She returns to Woodsboro for her book tour, and reconnects with old friends Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) and Sheriff Dewey (David Arquette). However, Sidney's arrival also sparks the return of Ghostface, putting Sidney and everyone she loves in danger. (Horror, Comedy) - 2011

screenpixvoices.us.title: Diary of a Hitman
screenpixvoices.us.description: A veteran hit man, Dekker (Forest Whitaker) is ready to call it quits and leave the profession. Dekker's final job, however, proves to be trickier than expected when the sadistic Zidzyck (Lewis Smith) recruits the assassin to kill his wife, Jain (Sherilyn Fenn), along with the couple's baby. While Dekker has a change of heart and resolves not to shoot Jain and her child, his decision places all their lives in danger, since Zidzyck has dispatched another killer to perform the task. (Crime drama) - 1992

screenpixvoices.us.title: Getting Even
screenpixvoices.us.description: Rival Texas chemical magnates (Edward Albert, Joe Don Baker) hold Dallas hostage over nerve gas stolen from the Soviets. (Thriller) - 1986

screenpixvoices.us.title: Deadly Intent
screenpixvoices.us.description: An adventurer's boss (Maud Adams) and other villains want his widow (Lisa Eilbacher) to lead them to his South American jewels. (Thriller) - 1988

screenpixvoices.us.title: Eve of Destruction
screenpixvoices.us.description: An anti-terrorist (Gregory Hines) hunts a walking bomb made by a scientist (Renée Soutendijk) in her own image, with all of her hang-ups. (Science fiction) - 1990

screenpixvoices.us.title: Slaughter
screenpixvoices.us.description: After his parents are killed by a car bomb, a former Green Beret named Slaughter (Jim Brown) begins investigating and is shocked to discover they were targets of a Mafia hit. He decides to settle the score on his own and successfully takes out some of the gangsters responsible before being caught by police. Now faced with a murder charge, Slaughter strikes a deal with government officials to have the charges dropped provided he can find and kill another gangster who's since fled to Mexico. (Action) - 1972

screenpixvoices.us.title: Sugar Hill
screenpixvoices.us.description: When nightclub owner Langston (Larry D. Johnson) refuses to sell out to local mob boss Morgan (Robert Quarry), he is beaten to death by a gang of hired thugs. His grief-stricken fiancée, Diana "Sugar" Hill (Marki Bey), vows revenge for his murder and turns to aged voodoo authority Mama Maitresse (Zara Cully). Together they conjure up the demonic spirit of Baron Samedi (Don Pedro Colley), who agrees to help Sugar. He raises an army of zombies and sets them upon Langston's killers. (Horror) - 1974

screenpixvoices.us.title: Blacula
screenpixvoices.us.description: During a visit to Transylvania, an African prince (William Marshall) gets turned into a vampire by Count Dracula (Charles Macaulay). Sealed in a coffin for several lifetimes, "Blacula" reawakens in the 1970s Los Angeles. Leaving a trail of bloodless victims in his wake, he pursues Lina (Vonetta McGee), a woman who bears a striking resemblance to his dead wife. Meanwhile, Dr. Gordon Thomas (Thalmus Rasulala) and top cop Lt. Peters (Gordon Pinsent) are hot on the bloodsucker's trail. (Horror) - 1972

screenpixvoices.us.title: Scream Blacula Scream
screenpixvoices.us.description: When a hated rival, Lisa Fortier (Pam Grier), is chosen to lead the voodoo cult of Willis Daniels' (Richard Lawson) late mother, a vengeful Willis brings the doomed vampire Prince Mamuwalde (William Marshall) back to life. Willis soon finds the vampire too powerful to control, and Lisa agrees to perform a spell that will break the curse placed on the prince. But, when racist sheriff Dunlop (Michael Conrad) gets involved, the vampire unleashes his deadly revenge. (Horror) - 1973

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Mercenary
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Sergei Kowalski, a mercenary only out for himself and a few dollars, joins up with a Mexican peasant-turned-revolutionary, Paco Roman, when the price is right. No longer content to toil for the rich and powerful, Roman plans to bring a new order to Mexico by force with his small ragtag group. While Roman and Kowalski are outnumbered facing the Mexican army, they also have to contend with Curly, a vengeful killer out for blood. (Western) - 1968

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Adiós, Sabata
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Gunslinger Sabata (Yul Brynner) allies himself with a group of wily Mexican revolutionaries scheming to overthrow Emperor Maximilian and expel the occupying Austrians from their homeland. Part of their plan involves stealing a shipment of gold and using it to purchase artillery. It won't be easy, however, as the gold is under the protection of the corrupt and sadistic Col. Skimmel (Gerard Herter). As Sabata pulls off the daring heist, he must take on dozens of enraged Austrian forces. (Western) - 1970

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Sitting Bull
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Recognizing that Maj. Robert Parrish (Dale Robertson) has a history of making peace with Native American tribes, President Ulysses S. Grant (John Hamilton) sends him to iron out a land dispute with Chief Sitting Bull (J. Carrol Naish). Though negotiations seem to be going well, Parrish can't stop the deadly Battle of Little Big Horn. Many die, but when he helps Sitting Bull survive, Parrish is charged with crimes against the government, and he will be executed unless Grant steps in. (Western) - 1954

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Top Gun
screenpixwesterns.us.description: When Rick Martin (Sterling Hayden) goes back to his hometown to warn the townspeople of an imminent attack by marauders, he finds he has been exiled due to his reputation as a gunslinger for hire. Martin discovers that his late mother had been cheated out of her homestead by Canby Judd (William Bishop), who is now affianced to Martin's childhood sweetheart, Laura Mead (Karin Booth). Martin must clear his tarnished name, bring Judd to justice and save the town from the marauders. (Western) - 1955

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Terror in a Texas Town
screenpixwesterns.us.description: When Swedish-American whaler George Hansen returns to his Texas hometown after 20 years at sea, he's shocked to learn that his father was murdered just two days prior. The feckless local sheriff won't do anything about it, so George investigates on his own and discovers that an oil speculator had his father killed for refusing to sell his land at an unfair price. Enraged, and armed only with a speargun, George goes looking for justice. (Western) - 1958

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - The Disappearance of Bat Masterson
screenpixwesterns.us.description: A magician unwittingly helps three bank robbers when he disarms Bat as part of a magic trick; the repentant magician teams up with Bat to pull a trick on the robbers and recover the money. (Western) - 1960-03-10

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - The Snare
screenpixwesterns.us.description: In Yuma, Bat joins a posse to hunt down Yaqui Kid, an outlaw who murdered a bride's fiancé just before her wedding. (Western) - 1960-03-17

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - The Injury
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Ed Keel is out for revenge on an injured Hollister after the hanging of his brother. (Western) - 1960-06-24

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - Crime Epidemic
screenpixwesterns.us.description: The Burnett brothers take refuge in a couple's barn cellar following a bank robbery. (Western) - 1960-07-01

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Pioneer Woman
screenpixwesterns.us.description: In this 19th-century drama, an American family from the Northeast heads to Wyoming in search of a better life, only to face tragedy and hardship. Maggie Sergent (Joanna Pettet), the hard-driving matriarch of the clan, is totally unprepared when her husband, John (William Shatner), is murdered. Left to handle the farm on her own, Maggie must choose whether to stay in Wyoming and run the farm with her children, or head back to the East Coast and the life she knows. (Western) - 1973

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Trooper Hook
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Wanted for killing a squadron of soldiers, Apache Chief Nanchez (Rudolfo Acosta) is finally captured by Sgt. Clovis Hook (Joel McCrea), who discovers among Nanchez's prisoners Cora Sutliff (Barbara Stanwyck), who had been missing for several years. Sutliff has not only fully integrated into the Apache way of life, she also has a son with Nanchez. Now Hook wants to transport her back to her old way of life, but Nanchez isn't willing to let his son be taken from him. (Western) - 1957

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Westward Bound
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Corrupt politician Albert Lane (Weldon Heyburn), town councilor Roger Caldwell (Harry Woods) and tax agent Henry Wagner (Karl Hackett) plot to steal the land of Montana ranchers. The ranchers, led by feisty Jasper Tuttle (Hal Price) and Enid Barrett (Betty Miles), band together to fight back. With the help of a trio of virtuous U.S. marshals called the Trail Blazers (Ken Maynard, Hoot Gibson, Bob Steele), the honest ranchers tangle with the politicians' henchmen. (Western) - 1944

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Utah Kid
screenpixwesterns.us.description: A lawman and a rodeo rider go after a gang that's been bribing and doping rodeo contestants to affect the outcome and make a bundle of cash. (Western) - 1944

screenpixwesterns.us.description: The uncle of an accused man sets a lethal trap for Bat at a Mexican ranch to prevent him from testifying at his nephew's trial. (Western) - 1960-03-24

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - The Reluctant Witness
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Bat helps Ellie Winters look for a missing witness to deliver testimony that can clear her of a false murder charge, and he recruits Wyatt Earp as a lawyer. (Western) - 1960-03-31

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - Gunslinger From Galeville
screenpixwesterns.us.description: The sheriff must collect taxes from a group of outlaws who are occupying different hideouts far from Tombstone but within the county; Clay uses the services of Curly Bill Brocius. (Western) - 1957-10-16

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - Reward for a Gunslinger
screenpixwesterns.us.description: After an outlaw escapes from a stagecoach hold-up killing, Claiborne spearheads a drive in Tombstone to raise a reward for his capture; two shady bounty hunters plan to get the reward. (Western) - 1957-10-23

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Hills Run Red
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Confederate soldiers Jerry Brewster (Thomas Hunter) and Ken Seagull (Nando Gazzolo) steal a fortune from the U.S. Army. But, when the partners in crime are ambushed by Union troops, they have to split up; Seagull escapes with the money, and Brewster gets a five-year jail sentence. When Brewster gets out, he discovers that his old crony is responsible for the death of his beloved wife. With the help of a gunslinger named Getz (Dan Duryea), Brewster embarks on a quest for vengeance. (Western) - 1966

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Revolt at Fort Laramie
screenpixwesterns.us.description: At the dawn of the American Civil War, tensions begin to mount between Northern and Southern sympathizers stationed at Fort Laramie in Wyoming. The Southern soldiers, led by Maj. Seth Bradner (John Dehner), leave Fort Laramie to join the Confederate cause. But when Bradner is captured by a fortune-seeking Sioux tribe en route to Texas, it's up to Capt. James Tenslip (Gregg Palmer), a Northerner who has fallen for Bradner's niece Melissa (Frances Helm), to save him. (Western) - 1957

sbssydney.au.description: This programme is driven by the soundtrack of the time, which kept the troops company in Vietnam, powered the Anti-War and Civil Rights movements, and opened the hearts of baby boomers.

sbssydney.au.description: S1 E8 Marlborough, NZ For the finale, Matt crosses to Marlborough, home to world famous Sauvignon Blanc, cooks King Salmon in Picton Harbour and plates one last meal to close the journey.

sbssydney.au.description: E274 Episode 274 Latest reports and analysis of major national and international news of the day from Australia's only world news service.

sbssydney.au.title: Hollywood Crime Story
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E3 Episode 3 In the 1970s and 80s, mob money floods Hollywood. Murder and scandal follow as the FBI closes in.

sbssydney.au.title: 9/11: One Day In America
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E6 It's All Gone, Kid In the aftermath of the towers collapsing, two former Marines and an ex-paramedic head to ground zero to search for survivors.

sbssydney.au.title: Indiana Jones: In Pursuit Of An Icon
sbssydney.au.description: Whip in hand, fedora tipped, and that daring grin - Indiana Jones, the ultimate adventurer, is celebrated from Lyon's Cinema Museum to Cannes, with Harrison Ford honouring his legendary legacy.

sbssydney.au.title: SBS World News Late ᴺᵉʷ
sbssydney.au.description: E184 Episode 184 Latest reports and analysis of major national and international news of the day from Australia's only world news service.

sbssydney.au.title: Reyka
sbssydney.au.description: S2 E8 Episode 8 In the season finale, another brutal murder at Lover's Lane leads Reyka deep into the sex worker trade and to the truth behind what happened to Jodie's mother.

sbssydney.au.title: Snow
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E1 Episode 1 Lucia, a medical doctor, moves with her family to the mountain village of Rotten. Her daughter suffers from severe asthma and the mountain air is supposed to alleviate Alma's illness.

sbssydney.au.title: Snow
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E2 Episode 2 The legend of the Guardian of The Mountains haunts Alma. The corpse of a young woman is said to be up on the Muttstein. At the thawing edge of the glacier, Alm's premonition becomes reality.

sbssydney.au.title: Snow
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E3 Episode 3 It's certain: Marianne was murdered. Inspector Prochazka starts an investigation. Alma is being questioned and Lucia discovers eerie parallels to the dead Marianne.

sbssydney.au.title: Cold War Spies
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E3 A Cold War Of Spies The Cold War is at its peak and with it the espionage activity. We focus on double agents, spies who work for both sides. Who can be trusted and who has been flipped?

sbssydney.au.title: Cold War Spies
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E4 A Cold War Of Spies During the Cold War two ideological hemispheres were created. Propaganda and media become the weapons of choice. In this episode, we show what the spread of false news means.

sbssydney.au.title: Bamay

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Hook
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Grown-up Peter Pan has to return to Neverland to rediscover his true identity in order to rescue his children from the clutches of the evil Captain Hook. Peter has grown up into a workaholic executive but takes time off for a holiday in London. Once there, his children are kidnapped by Hook, and Peter must throw off his corporate image and go back to Neverland to save his children.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Annie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Daddy Warbucks opens his estate to a spunky orphan in this adaptation of the popular comic strip and hit Broadway show.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Addams Family
skycinemafamily.uk.description: The lives of Gomez and Morticia Addams are thrown into disarray when a scheming siren attempts to pass off her son as Gomez's long-lost brother Fester. Once installed in the family's spooky mansion, mother and son set their minds on stealing the family fortune.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Addams Family Values
skycinemafamily.uk.description: With Wednesday and Pugsley off to summer camp, a greedy nanny plots to marry and murder wealthy Uncle Fester.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Tom and Jerry: Forbidden Compass
skycinemafamily.uk.description: When Tom and Jerry are transported through time to a distant era, they must work together to find a way back home.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Flushed Away
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A spoiled but lonely pet rat gets flushed down the toilet and finds himself stranded in London's sewer underworld. A savvy scavenger helps him evade frog assassins, but his attempts to help escalate the conflict put them both in deadly danger.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Casper
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A lonely boy-ghost befriends the young daughter of a ghost hunter. A grasping heiress calls in the exorcist to clear out the spooks and gain access to the treasures supposedly hidden in the lonely mansion. Father and daughter discover that Casper is not the only spirit haunting the house and find themselves caught up in an adventure.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Addams Family
skycinemafamily.uk.description: The lives of Gomez and Morticia Addams are thrown into disarray when a scheming siren attempts to pass off her son as Gomez's long-lost brother Fester. Once installed in the family's spooky mansion, mother and son set their minds on stealing the family fortune.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Addams Family Values
skycinemafamily.uk.description: With Wednesday and Pugsley off to summer camp, a greedy nanny plots to marry and murder wealthy Uncle Fester.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Johnny English
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Spoof spy caper with the eponymous, blundering hero attempting to recover the crown jewels and save Britain from an evil mastermind when all the other agents are killed. Promoted from lowly pen pusher to super spy, Johnny English is baffled when clues lead to respected entrepreneur Pascal Sauvage, but could the enigmatic Lorna hold the key to the mystery?

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Johnny English Reborn
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A haphazard spy returns to MI-7 after years in a Tibetan monastery honing his Zen skills. Armed with gizmos, gadgets and chaotic luck he takes on a global ring of assassins.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Johnny English Strikes Again
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Johnny English springs back into action when a hacker reveals the identities of undercover agents in Britain. As a man with few skills and analogue methods, Johnny must overcome the challenges of modern technology to make this mission a success.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Cloudy With a Chance of Meatballs
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Inventor Flint Lockwood dreams of discovering an idea that will change people's lives forever, and after several misguided attempts he may just have done it. Flint has invented a machine that can turn water into delicious food, and, when his first demonstration accidentally sends the machine shooting into the clouds, cheeseburgers begin raining down from the sky.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Cloudy With a Chance of Meatballs 2
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Discovering that his most famous machine is now creating animal/vegetable hybrids, inventor Flint Lockwood and his friends venture forth to save the world from tacodiles, shrimpanzees and other creatures.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Silent Running
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: After the end of all botanical life on Earth, ecologist Freeman Lowell (Bruce Dern) maintains a greenhouse on a space station in order to preserve various plants for future generations. Assisted by three robots and a small human crew, Lowell rebels when he is ordered to destroy the greenhouse in favor of carrying cargo, a decision that puts him at odds with everyone but his mechanical companions. Lowell and his robots are forced to do anything necessary to keep their invaluable greenery alive. (Science fiction) - 1972

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: No Blade of Grass
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A Londoner (Nigel Davenport) leads his wife (Jean Wallace) and family through anarchy after a virus wipes out the world's crops. (Science fiction) - 1970

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Them!
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: While investigating a series of mysterious deaths, Sergeant Ben Peterson (James Whitmore) finds a young girl (Sandy Descher) who is unable to speak. As Peterson joins forces with FBI agent Robert Graham (James Arness) and scientist Dr. Harold Medford (Edmund Gwenn), he discovers that all the incidents are due to giant ants that have been mutated by atomic radiation. Peterson and Graham, with the aid of the military, attempt to find the queen ants and destroy the nests before the danger spreads. (Science fiction, Horror) - 1954

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Swarm
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Scientist Dr. Bradford Crane and army general Thalius Slater join forces to fight an almost invisible enemy threatening America; killer bees that have deadly venom and attack without reason. Disaster movie-master Irwin Allen's film contains spectacular special effects, including a train crash caused by the eponymous swarm. (Horror) - 1978

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: MGM Parade
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Clip of Judy Garland and Gene Kelly in "For Me and My Gal"; host George Murphy. (Documentary, Entertainment) - 1955-11-23

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Little Women
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The March sisters -- Meg (Janet Leigh), Jo (June Allyson), Beth (Margaret O'Brien) and Amy (Elizabeth Taylor) -- struggle to make ends meet in their New England household while their father is away fighting in the Civil War. Despite harsh times, they cling to optimism, often with neighbor Laurie (Peter Lawford) as a companion. As they mature, they face burgeoning ambitions and relationships, as well as tragedy, all the while maintaining their unbreakable bond. (Drama, Romance) - 1949

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Summertime
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Middle-aged Ohio secretary Jane Hudson (Katharine Hepburn) has never found love and has nearly resigned herself to spending the rest of her life alone. But before she does, she uses her savings to finance a summer in romantic Venice, where she finally meets the man of her dreams, the elegant Renato Di Rossi (Rossano Brazzi). But when she learns that her new paramour is leading a double life, she must decide whether her happiness can come at the expense of others. (Romance) - 1955

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: South Pacific
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Nurse Nellie Forbush of the U.S. Navy falls for middle-aged French plantation owner Emile De Becque, but recoils upon discovering that he's fathered two mixed-race children. When Nellie leaves him, the heartbroken Emile agrees to take on a dangerous espionage mission. In his absence, Nellie struggles to reconcile her prejudices with her love for him -- and after she spends time with his children and comes to care for them, fears that Emile may not return alive. (Musical) - 1958

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Count Your Blessings
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: American Grace Allingham (Deborah Kerr) marries Frenchman Charles Edouard de Valhubert (Rossano Brazzi), but their marriage quickly becomes unusual. Because Charles cheats on her and lives away from his family out of professional obligation to his government, Grace ends up raising the couple's son, Sigismond (Martin Stephens), on her own. Grace and Charles are finally reunited after nearly a decade apart, and, while they seem headed for a permanent split, there's still a spark between them. (Comedy) - 1959

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Light in the Piazza
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Meg Johnson (Olivia de Havilland) is very protective of her daughter, Clara (Yvette Mimieux), a gorgeous young woman who suffers from a mental disability. While on vacation in Italy, Clara meets the dashing Fabrizio Naccarelli (George Hamilton), who is immediately smitten with her and doesn't initially grasp the extent of her developmental handicap. Though Meg is wary of letting Clara fall into a romance with Fabrizio, she realizes that he may be able to give the girl a better life. (Drama) - 1962

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Rome Adventure
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Prudence (Suzanne Pleshette), a feisty but romantic-minded young librarian at an all-female school in New England, resigns from her job after getting disciplined for recommending a banned book to one of her students. Impulsively deciding to summer in Rome, she's romanced by the smooth Roberto (Rossano Brazzi) and becomes friends with American architect Don (Troy Donahue), who is trying to extricate himself from a failed relationship with the emotionally needy Lyda (Angie Dickinson). (Romance, Drama) - 1962

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Bobo
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An impresario will let a clumsy matador (Peter Sellers) sing at his theater if he seduces the biggest flirt (Britt Ekland) in Barcelona. (Comedy) - 1967

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Queen Bee
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In the 1950s American South, the vicious and conniving Eva Phillips (Joan Crawford) makes the lives of those around her miserable -- especially her husband, Avery (Barry Sullivan), who resorts to heavy drinking and becomes an alcoholic. Meanwhile, when Eva discovers her sister-in-law (Betsy Palmer) is to wed her former lover (John Ireland), she really becomes nasty. Witnessing Eva's cruel exploits is Avery's cousin, Jennifer Stewart (Lucy Marlow), who can only stand by, mortified. (Drama) - 1955

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Nanny
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Nanny (Bette Davis), a London family's live-in maid, brings morbid 10-year-old Joey (William Dix) back from the psychiatric ward he's been in for two years, since the death of his younger sister. Joey refuses to eat any food Nanny's prepared or take a bath with her in the room. He also demands to sleep in a room with a lock. Joey's parents -- workaholic Bill (James Villiers) and neurotic Virgie (Wendy Craig) -- are sure Joey is disturbed, but he may have good reason to be terrified of Nanny. (Horror) - 1965

ABCMESydney.au.title: Iyanu ᴺᵉʷ

ABCMESydney.au.title: Adventure Time

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Amazing World of Gumball ᴺᵉʷ

ABCMESydney.au.title: Unikitty ᴺᵉʷ

ABCMESydney.au.title: Submarine Jim ᴺᵉʷ

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Michel Roux's French Country Cooking

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Episode 4 Join Adam Liaw as he revisits the highlights from his Scandinavian food adventures.

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Time To Bake Macaroons may look unbelievably difficult to make, but really, they are just posh meringues and Lorraine has a recipe to make them with ease. Mini Tiramisu Cakes are a delicious and playful twist.

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E11 Olives In California Spanish missionaries brought olive trees to California in the 1700's. Centuries later, California is a leading producer of olives and olive oil.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E4 Episode 4 Laura has the sweetest of all Greek cooks on the show, Kathy Tsaples, who is making a mouth-watering traditional Papoutsakia, or 'Little Slippers'.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Spaghetti And Meatballs Rachael cooks up her family's favourite version of spaghetti and meatballs with a Tuscan flair.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S5 E8 Episode 8 Hayden pushes further north this week as he heads to Bundaberg! Hayden also visits the Mon Repos Turtle Centre for a chance to see baby loggerhead turtles hatching!

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet: Sweet Edition
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E5 Episode 5 Things turn deliciously creamy as Natalie Paull's Featherlight Cream Sponge Cake steals the show, and Justine's mango and tequila sorbet adds a refreshing zing.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E7 North East England In Wakefield, Rick makes a sublime rhubarb crumble and meets Janet Oldroyd, whose family have been farming rhubarb for four generations.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E28 Episode 28 Develop your prowess in the kitchen with one of Australia’s most loved cooks, Justine Schofield. Along with an array of amazing guests Justine inspires cooks of all skill levels to be more ambitious and creative in their kitchens.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S5 E8 Episode 8 Hayden pushes further north this week as he heads to Bundaberg! Hayden also visits the Mon Repos Turtle Centre for a chance to see baby loggerhead turtles hatching!

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet: Sweet Edition
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E5 Episode 5 Things turn deliciously creamy as Natalie Paull's Featherlight Cream Sponge Cake steals the show, and Justine's mango and tequila sorbet adds a refreshing zing.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cooking Italy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: E9 Tuscany Part 2 Francesco, the owner of Poggio Foco, sends Chefs Rob and Craig to his favourite local cheese production house famous for ricotta and pecorino.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E7 North East England In Wakefield, Rick makes a sublime rhubarb crumble and meets Janet Oldroyd, whose family have been farming rhubarb for four generations.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E28 Episode 28 Develop your prowess in the kitchen with one of Australia’s most loved cooks, Justine Schofield. Along with an array of amazing guests Justine inspires cooks of all skill levels to be more ambitious and creative in their kitchens.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E61 Go Fish It's a game of go fish where everyone wins, as Adam, chef Rosy Scatigna and performer-cook Paul Mercurio make their favourite fish dishes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie At Home
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Carrots And Beets Purple, white and gold carrots, pink and white striped beetroots. The garden throws up a multicoloured feast of beautiful carrots and beets that form the basis of Jamie's recipes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S7 E25 All About Grandma Grandma Erminia's favourites grace today's menu and include a rice and pea soup; a simple prosciutto cotto sandwich and a dish that the family finds on many Sunday menus: baked stuffed shells.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Michel Roux's French Country Cooking
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E5 Brunch Michel makes a decadent brunch starting with cheese souffles. A visit to a historic restaurant in Avignon inspires a classic smoked chicken and mushrooms pithivier, then a wine jelly with fruits.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E15 The Sun Makers: Part 3 The Doctor is free but Leela has been captured by the Gatherer and is sentenced to a grisly death by public steaming.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E17 Underworld: Part 1 The TARDIS lands on a spaceship which is crewed by the survivors of the planet Minyos who are on a quest to find the lost ship, the P7E. Their journey has taken them 100,000 years.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E19 Underworld: Part 3 The Doctor and Leela attempt to penetrate the Citadel of the Seers to rescue Idas’s father who has been sentenced to death.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E20 Underworld: Part 4 The Minyans are eager to recover the race banks that they have waited so long to find, but the Doctor becomes suspicious when the Oracle simply allows Jackson to take them.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E21 The Invasion of Time: Part 1 Leela is concerned by the Doctor’s strange behaviour when, after a secret meeting with aliens, he returns to Gallifrey and abruptly stakes his claim on the Time Lord presidency.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E22 The Invasion of Time: Part 2 The Doctor is made president of the Time Lords and immediately orders K9 to lower the planet’s defences and has Leela banished to the wilderness.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E23 The Invasion of Time: Part 3 The Doctor has betrayed his own people and enabled a Vardan invasion of Gallifrey. Leela joins forces with the Outsiders and prepares to strike back against the aliens.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E24 The Invasion of Time: Part 4 As the Vardans finally fully materialise on Gallifrey, the Doctor prepares to spring his trap. But does a more deadly alien force lie behind the Vardans?

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E25 The Invasion of Time: Part 5 The Sontarans have taken control of the Capital on Gallifrey and intend to use the power of the Time Lords to rampage through all of time.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E3 The Ribos Operation: Part 3 The Doctor and Romana's search for the first segment of the Key to Time is hampered when the Graff Vynda-K takes them prisoner.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E4 The Ribos Operation: Part 4 Pursued into the catacombs by the Graff and attacked by the ferocious Shrivenzale, the Doctor and Romana struggle to stay alive and find the first segment of the Key to Time.

However, as Colm's resolve only strengthens, he soon delivers an ultimatum that leads to shocking consequences. (Dark comedy) - 2022

While many dismiss her claims, certain people, including the priest Dominique Peyramale (Charles Bickford), slowly begin to believe her. Eventually, Bernadette is deemed a saint, and becomes a nun at a convent, where she must deal with jealousy from others who resent her revered status. (Drama) - 1943

fxm.us.title: The Book of Life

Although their lives have taken different paths -- Maria was sent to Europe, Joaquin joined the military, and Manolo studied to become a bullfighter -- one thing remains the same: Manolo and Joaquin both want to marry Maria. Little does the trio know that battling husband-and-wife deities have made a high-stakes wager on the love triangle's outcome. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2014

fxm.us.title: Rebecca of Sunnybrook Farm

Meanwhile, advertising exec Tony Kent (Randolph Scott) desperately searches for Rebecca, who he has only heard, unaware that she's on the farm next to his. Tony's search is interrupted by many things -- including Rebecca's attractive cousin, Gwen (Gloria Stuart). (Musical) - 1938

5starmax.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
5starmax.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue. (War, Historical drama) - 1987

5starmax.us.title: Fantastic Planet
5starmax.us.description: This animated tale follows the relationship between the small human-like Oms and their much larger blue-skinned oppressors, the Draags, who rule the planet of Ygam. While the Draags have long kept Oms as illiterate pets, this hierarchy shifts after an Om boy becomes educated, thanks to a young female Draag. This leads to an Om rebellion, which weakens the Draag control over their race. Will the Oms and the Draags find a way to coexist? Or will they destroy each other? (Animated, Science fiction) - 1973

5starmax.us.title: A History of Violence
5starmax.us.description: When a pair of petty criminals attempt to rob his small-town diner, Tom Stall (Viggo Mortensen) quickly and easily kills them both. In the flush of news coverage of Tom's seemingly heroic actions, a threatening stranger named Carl Fogarty (Ed Harris) comes to town, fingering the unassuming family man as long-missing Philadelphia mobster Joey Cusack. To the horror of his wife, Edie (Maria Bello), and teenage son, Jack (Ashton Holmes), Tom finds he must confront his violent past. (Drama, Thriller) - 2005

5starmax.us.title: Mississippi Masala

The families and their surrounding communities begin to feud, putting even more pressure on the couple's romance. Having to choose between family and love, Mina and Demetrius run away together. (Comedy drama) - 1991

5starmax.us.title: MacGruber
5starmax.us.description: In the decade since his fiancée was killed, an Army Ranger, Green Beret and Navy SEAL rolled into one has sworn off fighting crime, preferring instead to rock his mullet as a man of peace. But when his sworn enemy, Dieter Von Cunth, steals a nuclear warhead, only MacGruber and his crack team of experts are equal to the task of bringing the villain to justice. (Comedy, Action) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: The Daytrippers

Going home to her family for comfort, Eliza sets out with her mother, father, sister and her sister's boyfriend in the family car to track down and confront Louis. Always one step behind him, the family learns a lot about each other in the process. (Comedy) - 1996

discoveryscience.us.description: Weapons of mass destruction now include chemical, hypersonic and cyber threats. Like any weapon, cyberattacks can cripple nations, threatening society's survival. (Documentary, History)

discoveryscience.us.title: Modern Warfare 2.0 - Shock and Awe
discoveryscience.us.description: Directed energy weapons, once only seen in science fiction, are now reality. They can disable cities' circuits and destroy missiles, heralding space warfare. (Documentary, History)

discoveryscience.us.title: NASA's Unexplained Files - Ghosts on the Moon
discoveryscience.us.description: Spaceships powered by atomic bombs; artificial rings encircle an entire star; Neil Armstrong's transmission feed cuts off when he spots strange lights on the moon; how can lightning talk to itself. (Documentary, Science)

discoveryscience.us.title: NASA's Unexplained Files - Attack of the Thunderballs
discoveryscience.us.description: Astronauts evacuate when a mystery object hurtles toward the ISS; a NASA secret agent goes undercover to retrieve missing moon rocks; scientists struggle to find answers when they discover a huge void at the edge of the solar system. (Documentary, Science)

discoveryscience.us.title: NASA's Unexplained Files - Red Storm Rising
discoveryscience.us.description: Two astronauts trapped in the vacuum of space face a horrible death; the first close up images of Pluto show an alien landscape; residents of Houston struggle to explain videos of unidentified flying lights captured above their city at night. (Documentary, Science)

discoveryscience.us.title: How the Universe Works - Nightmares of Neutron Stars
discoveryscience.us.description: Neutron stars are strange and violent phenomena that defy the laws of physics, and new discoveries reveal that these bizarre nightmares are far more deadly than previously believed, with the power to destroy planets and even other stars. (Science, Documentary)

discoveryscience.us.title: How the Universe Works - Battle of the Dark Universe

discoveryscience.us.title: Mysteries of the Abandoned - The Ruins of Troy

discoveryscience.us.title: Mysteries of the Abandoned - Turkish Wonderland

filmriseaction.us.title: The 51st State
filmriseaction.us.description: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American. (Action, Comedy) - 2001

filmriseaction.us.title: Freejack
filmriseaction.us.description: Early in the 21st century, technological advances have made it possible for aging, wealthy people to pay crooks like Vacendak (Mick Jagger) to go back in time, kidnap young victims like race car driver Alex Furlong (Emilio Estevez) and deliver them to the elderly clients, who then have their brains transplanted into the healthy bodies. Furlong manages to break free from his captors, but as a fugitive, he finds that the world of the future is a bleak, dangerous place. (Science fiction) - 1992

filmriseaction.us.title: Blitz

filmriseaction.us.title: The Gunman
filmriseaction.us.description: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery) - 2015

filmriseaction.us.title: Eye See You

He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one. (Thriller) - 2002

With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag. (Action, Thriller) - 2006

fifthgear.us.description: S13 E03 Vicki finds out which is quickest, an old Vauxhall against a new one; Jonny Smith and Tom Ford contest one of motor sport's oldest and most grueling events, the Exeter Trial; Tiff Needell goes to France to drive the new Audi A3 Cabriolet.

fifthgear.us.description: S13 E07 Vicki is at the controls in a classic Ford v Vauxhall battle, two boy racer specials, the Fiesta ST and Corsa SRi, wage war to find out which is fastest; Tom journeys to the Arctic Circle to test the Volvo XC70, an estate car with four-wheel drive.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E08 Vicki Butler-Henderson is in Anglesey for another Fifth Gear shoot-out. This week it's the Porsche Cayenne GTS against the BMW X5. Tom Ford drives the new C5 and Tiff Needell tests the new Subaru Impreza STi.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E09 Vicki Butler-Henderson finds out which is quickest, the VW Golf GTI or Subaru Impreza WRX; Jonny Smith proves there are still some cars that you can buy for under $1,500.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E10 Vicki takes the Focus RS and the Escort Cosworth to find out once and for all which handles best around a track; Jason drives the Grand Tourer and delivers his verdict whether the £78,000 asking price would represent money well spent.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E01 Tim Shaw joins the team, and he's been specially tasked with standing up for the beleaguered motorist; Jason Plato and Tiff Needell go head-to-head on the track to find out which car is fastest.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E02 Tiff Needell takes two coupes onto the Fifth Gear track, the Mazda RX8 and Nissan 350Z; Vicki Butler-Henderson spends a day with Formula One star Lewis Hamilton; Tom Ford is the lucky man behind the wheel of the facelifted Mercedes SL63 AMG.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E03 Jason Plato races two estates head to head; Vicki Butler-Henderson pits the new Pro-Ceed against the VW Golf; Jonny Smith picks up an amazing luxury car for £1000 or less; Tiff Needell runs the most exciting car vs. bike race to date.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E04 Jason Plato pitches a lunatic Honda Civic Mugen RR imported from Japan against a Honda S2000 sports car from the UK; Jonny Smith tests the VW Passat CC v Mercedes CLS; Tiff Needell takes to the track to test the brand new KTM X-Bow.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E05 Tiff and Jason race two V8 mega-saloons. Tom has the only television test of the Dodge Challenger.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E06 Tim Shaw tests whether manufacturers' claimed 0-62mph acceleration times are actually true or not; Vicki Butler-Henderson heads out to the track in two Porsches.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E07 Tom Ford tests the brand new Ford Fiesta; Vicki Butler-Henderson and Tiff Needell challenge each other on two wheels; Jonny shows us three great cars we could all suddenly afford to buy if we were to all stop drinking.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E08 Jason and Tiff battle against each other in the purest form of motor-sport: karting; Dirk Benedict joins Jonny Smith in a luxury road test with a difference; Tom Ford tests the Renault Laguna.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E09 Jason meets Moto GP star James Toseland in a feature where "Fifth Gear" makes a sports star's dream come true.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E05 Tom Ford puts the Grande Punto Abarth through its hot hatch paces; Tim Shaw finds out if it's possible to save huge amounts of money by servicing a car yourself; Bruno Senna is a special guest presenter.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S15 E01 Tiff and Jason head for the racetrack in the KTM X-Bow and Lotus 2-Eleven; Jonny investigates the smarter and apparently plusher qualities to be found in the latest Golf; Tom conducts a crash test which is essential viewing for all families.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S15 E02 Jason pits the tiny Renault Sport Twingo 133 against the Renault 5 GT Turbo; Tom finds out Vauxhall's replacement for the Vectra; Tim relives the terror of his driving test to find out why fewer people than ever are passing their test.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S15 E03 Jason pits two diesel coupes against each other; Jonny braves the freezing weather to show off three cabriolets, with a budget of just £5,000; Tom puts the Ford Fiesta against the Seat Ibiza in three tests; Tiff drives the Lamborghini Gallardo.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S15 E04 Vicki talks with the young rally sensation Tom Cave; Jason is at the annual Race of Champions.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S15 E05 Jason and BBC Radio 1 star Comedy Dave recreate a Ford Capri car chase scene from '70s UK TV show "The Professionals." Tim tests different car polishes.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S15 E06 Tiff pits Renault's Mégane hatch against a Caterham CDX sports car; Tim delves into the murky world of car crime; Jonny gives a consumer review of the new Ford Ka.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S15 E07 Tiff tests hatches including the Ford Focus RS; Vicki looks at a second-hand Lotus Elise; Quentin examines the personalized number plate market.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: Vicki meets 12 times Motor Trials champion and British motorcycling legend Dougie Lampkin; Jonny investigates another way of making cash from old cars; Jason takes the Ford Focus RS in the first TV drive of Ford's awesome new hot hatch.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S15 E09 Tim finds out which car washes are effective -- and which ones can permanently damage a car's paint.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S15 E10 The Vauxhall Astra GTE 16v and Ford Escort RS Turbo take on the Fifth Gear test track.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S16 E01 Featuring a death-defying loop-the-loop stunt, a race against David Coulthard, and a test to see if buying an old car can beat the credit crunch.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S23 E16 Vicki Butler-Henderson is in Italy testing the most powerful Ferrari ever made, the brand new 730bhp F12berlinetta, to the limit. Tiff and Jason are at the track with the two cheapest hot hatches on sale - the Suzuki Swift and Renault Sport Twingo.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: Vicki goes behind the scenes of famous Italian car designers Pininfarina - the people who have shaped every single Ferrari of the last 50 years. Tiff is joined by British rally star Mark Higgins in a test of two new SUVs with supercar power figures.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: Episode 18 Tiff is joined by German motoring legend, Sabine Schmitz, for a head-to-head battle between our two favorite sports cars of the last year, the BMW M6 and Porsche 911.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: Jason Plato and Tiff Needell hold a high octane track test of three brand-new super glamorous convertibles from Audi, Maserati and Mercedes. Vicki Butler-Henderson races wheel to wheel with World Superbike hotshot Chaz Davies.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: Vicki Butler-Henderson and Tiff Needell pit what could be the greatest drivers' car of the century - the Toyota GT86 - against its tough rival from Renault Sport. Jonny Smith is in Spain to put Jaguar's brand new F-Type through its paces.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: Jonny Smith reveals the secrets of 21st century car crash testing. He goes behind the scenes at a crash test performed by experts Euro NCAP, before conducting his own shocking crash test between a car and a van.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: Episode 4 Tiff Needell heads to LA to check out the latest car trend to take the USA restomodding; it's the art of sympathetically restoring classic cars to modern standards while retaining their original charm, Tiff's behind the wheel of LA's best examples.

shadesofblack.us.title: The Forgiven
shadesofblack.us.description: During his life sentence in post-apartheid South Africa, brutal murderer Piet Blomfeld seeks redemption through meetings with Archbishop Desmond Tutu. (Thriller, Drama) - 2017

shadesofblack.us.title: Morris From America
shadesofblack.us.description: A 13-year-old rapper (Markees Christmas) focused on hip-hop stardom falls for a rebellious classmate (Lina Keller) after moving from the U.S. to Germany with his widowed father (Craig Robinson). (Comedy drama) - 2016

shadesofblack.us.title: NOLA Circus
shadesofblack.us.description: A rivalry between competing barbershops in New Orleans escalates until it affects the owners' families and friends. (Comedy) - 2015

shadesofblack.us.title: Meet the Blacks
shadesofblack.us.description: When some unexpected money comes his way, Carl Black moves his family from cold and windy Chicago to bright and sunny Beverly Hills, Calif. As the Blacks settle into their beautiful new home, they start to notice some strange behavior in the neighborhood. Nighttime is approaching, and President El bama announces that the annual purge is about to begin. Carl and his loved ones must now endure a 12-hour period of lawlessness before they can enjoy life once again. (Comedy) - 2016

shadesofblack.us.title: Snoop Dogg's Hood of Horror
shadesofblack.us.description: The Hound of Hell (Snoop Dogg) is a guide through three stories from a neighborhood of depraved citizens. There is a tagger who discovers that not all gangsters die hard, a foolish Texas oil fortune heir who kills for money but can't afford to stay living, and a huge rap star who uncovers a few skeletons in his dressing room that try to kick down his door. (Horror) - 2006

shadesofblack.us.title: Crash
shadesofblack.us.description: Writer-director Paul Haggis interweaves several connected stories about race, class, family and gender in Los Angeles in the aftermath of 9/11. Characters include a district attorney (Brendan Fraser) and his casually prejudiced wife (Sandra Bullock), dating police detectives Graham (Don Cheadle) and Ria (Jennifer Esposito), a victimized Middle Eastern store owner and a wealthy African-American couple (Terrence Dashon Howard, Thandie Newton) humiliated by a racist traffic cop (Matt Dillon). (Drama) - 2004

shadesofblack.us.title: American Violet
shadesofblack.us.description: After an overzealous district attorney's drug bust lands her in jail, single mother Dee Roberts (Nicole Beharie) must face an agonizing choice: Plead guilty and go home a convicted felon, or fight the charges and risk a lengthy prison sentence. Despite her mother's (Alfre Woodard) advice and risking everything, innocent Dee chooses to fight the Texas criminal justice system, joined by an ACLU attorney (Tim Blake Nelson) and a former narcotics cop (Will Patton). (Drama) - 2008

shadesofblack.us.title: Monster's Ball
shadesofblack.us.description: Hank, an embittered racist prison guard working on death row, begins an unlikely, emotionally charged sexual relationship with Leticia, a Black woman and wife of a man sentenced to death. The affair begins just after Hank oversees the capital punishment of Leticia's husband. (Drama, Romance) - 2001

shadesofblack.us.title: Never Back Down
shadesofblack.us.description: Jake (Sean Faris) moves to Orlando, Fla., with his mother (Leslie Hope) and brother (Wyatt Smith). He feels like an outsider in his new school and frequently lets his temper flare out of control. But Jake wants to fit in, and he decides to go to a party with his classmate Baja (Amber Heard). There, Jake is pushed into a fight and humiliated. Another classmate (Evan Peters) sees what happened, and encourages Jake to visit martial arts trainer Jean Roqua (Djimon Hounsou). (Action) - 2008

shadesofblack.us.title: Falcon Rising
shadesofblack.us.description: A former Marine (Michael Jai White) travels to Brazil to hunt down the brutal Japanese mobsters who attacked his sister and left her for dead. (Action, Adventure, Martial arts, Thriller, Drama) - 2014

shadesofblack.us.title: Bad Ass 2 : Bad Asses
shadesofblack.us.description: Frank Vega (Danny Trejo) teams up with his agoraphobic buddy Bernie Pope (Danny Glover) to clean up Los Angeles' crime-infested streets. (Action, Comedy) - 2014

shadesofblack.us.title: Mad Money
shadesofblack.us.description: After her husband loses his job, upper-crust housewife Bridget Cardigan (Diane Keaton) is forced to take a job as a janitor at the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City, Mo. Spotting a weakness in the bank's security system, Bridget convinces her two new friends Nina (Queen Latifah) and Jackie (Katie Holmes) to help her steal a fortune in worn-out bills that have been earmarked for destruction. (Comedy) - 2008
