tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke arrives in Saigon for a breakfast of iced coffee with condensed milk and a vermicelli noodle dish. Later, he visits his favourite Pho restaurant, then cooks up some spicy Chilli Crab Claws. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Street Food Asia - Bangkok's Night Market
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke continues his street food journey in Bangkok where he searches for the best Tom Yum soup and entertains the locals with a rare Thai delicacy. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Street Food Asia - Jakarta's King of Street Food
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke continues his street food adventure exploring Jakarta, a melting pot of diverse cultural cuisines, where he indulges in an Indonesian dessert, the sweet Martabak, known as the "King of Street Food". (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: The Pizza City You've Never Heard Of
tastemadetravel.us.description: Disturbed by the fact that his hometown of Windsor, Ontario is typically overlooked on lists of the top pizza cities in the world, George Kalivas goes on a mission to set the record straight about where to find the best pies on the planet. (Documentary) - 2022-09-21

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The Italian Job
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred start their road trip in Gino's homeland of Italy, where Gino needs help to pull off an event that is close to his heart. Gino collects Gordon and Fred in a campervan to begin a road trip they won't be forgetting in a hurry. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The French Connection
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to France, where Fred has been asked to co-host an Oyster Festival in the beautiful Arcachon Bay, in just four days' time. Reunited with their campervan, Fred nominates himself as the driver in his homeland. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The Highland Fling
tastemadetravel.us.description: The trio heads to Scotland as Gordon prepares to cook a feast for the chief of Clan Ramsay and his friends. Gordon shows the others how to dress like real Scotsmen as they go in search of Scottish beef, hunt for scallops and play some Highland Games. (Cooking, Travel) - 2025-09-05

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Fire Kings
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gualberto "Weber" Elizondo surprised his family when his grilling hobby turned him into a local celebrity and internet sensation. Meanwhile, chef Chuy Villareal of Cara De Vaca wants the world to know that the north of Mexico isn't just carne asada. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Sisters, Stew, and Sass
tastemadetravel.us.description: Roasted tomatoes rice with cumin and oregano; chicken livers with chipotle caramelized onions; avocado and panela cheese salad. (Cooking) - 2022-09-16

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The World Cup of Tacos
tastemadetravel.us.description: Nuevo León is divided between two pro soccer teams: Los Tigres and Los Rayados. Pati tries the food at each stadium with the teams' stars to determine who wins in the battle of tortas vs tacos. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Bread Masters
tastemadetravel.us.description: Irving Quiroz wrote the book on Mexican bread. Pati visits his workshop for his secret to making the perfect campechana, then meets Chuy Elizondo, owner of one of the hottest brunch spots in town. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Magic of Piloncillo
tastemadetravel.us.description: The Garza family invites Pati to their vineyard to help the community make piloncillo - and it's hard work! Then, in the magic town of Bustamante, three sisters make traditional bread in adobe ovens. (Cooking) - 2025-10-01

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Pioneering From Farm to Table
tastemadetravel.us.description: Spicy honey, garlic and orange roasted duck; skillet corn tamal with duck fat and roasted garlic. (Cooking) - 2022-10-20

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Cantina Culture and the Morning After?
tastemadetravel.us.description: Cantinas have historically been bars where men gather to drink and sing about their broken hearts. Historian David Canales takes Pati to historic locations. Then she tries the best tacos in town. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Texas BBQ in the Orange Belt
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati visits BBQ champion Luis Rivas to taste his Mexican take on Texas-style BBQ, and he hosts a traditional carne asada at his family's orange grove. Then Pati learns how Glorias candies are made. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - A Day With Hugo
tastemadetravel.us.description: Chef Hugo Guajardo researches the best of Nuevo León's ingredients. He and Pati visit a family-owned restaurant that has perfected the art of drying meat. Then, she tries his famed charred chicken. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Top Chefs and Ancient Cliffs
tastemadetravel.us.description: Wedding rice; ginger and pistachio guacamole. (Cooking) - 2022-11-17

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Stunning Seafood of Marseille
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads to Marseille in the south of France. Inspired by their stunning seafood, the traditional flavors of Provence, and the multicultural dishes being served up there, he cooks up a steak with a twist and a sublime courgette and olive tart. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Traditional Greek Cuisine
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads to Greece, to the island of Skopelos, starting on the mainland in Thessaloniki. Inspired by meze plates and traditional island cuisine he cooks up a smoky aubergine flatbread and a lemony chargrilled chicken with tzatziki and rice. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Inspirational Spanish Tapas
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and aioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Making Couscous in Tunisia
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie explores Tunisia to meet traditional couscous makers, eat delicious street food, and get invited to cook with local chefs on a beach. Inspired by everything he sees, Jamie cooks crispy prawn parcels and a chicken and merguez sausage stew. (Cooking)

amc.ca.title: Poltergeist
amc.ca.description: Strange and creepy happenings beset an average California family, the Freelings - Steve (Craig T. Nelson), Diane (JoBeth Williams), teenaged Dana (Dominique Dunne), eight-year-old Robbie (Oliver Robins), and five-year-old Carol Ann (Heather O'Rourke) - when ghosts commune with them through the television set. Initially friendly and playful, the spirits turn unexpectedly menacing, and, when Carol Ann goes missing, Steve and Diane turn to a parapsychologist and eventually an exorcist for help. (Movie, Horror, Thriller) - 1982

amc.ca.title: Creepshow
amc.ca.description: A compendium of five short but terrifying tales contained within a single full-length feature, this film conjures scares from traditional bogeymen and portents of doom. In one story, a monster escapes from its holding cell. Another focuses on a husband (Leslie Nielsen) with a creative way of getting back at his cheating wife. Other stories concern a rural man (Stephen King) and a visitor from outer space, and a homeowner (E.G. Marshall) with huge bug problems and a boozing corpse. (Movie, Horror, Comedy, Fantasy) - 1982

Mike Enslin is a successful author who enjoys worldwide acclaim debunking supernatural phenomena - before he checks into the Dolphin Hotel, that is. Ignoring the warnings of the hotel manager, he learns the meaning of real terror when he spends the night in a reputedly haunted room. (Movie, Horror, Thriller, Fantasy, Mystery) - 2007

amc.ca.title: Pumpkinhead
amc.ca.description: After his son dies in a hit-and-run accident, Ed Harley seeks revenge against the teenagers responsible. With the help of a local witch, Ed summons the vengeful demon Pumpkinhead to hunt and kill the group of friends. But when Ed discovers a bond between himself and the creature, he begins to have second thoughts about employing the vicious monster, and he fights to end Pumpkinhead's murderous rampage before it is too late. (Movie, Horror) - 1988

amc.ca.title: Halloween III: Season of the Witch
amc.ca.description: Hospital emergency room Dr. Daniel "Dan" Challis (Tom Atkins) and Ellie Grimbridge (Stacey Nelkin), the daughter of a murder victim, uncover a terrible plot by small-town mask maker Conal Cochran (Dan O'Herlihy), a madman who's planning a Halloween mass murder utilizing an ancient Celtic ritual. The ritual involves a boulder stolen from Stonehenge, the use of Silver Shamrock masks and a triggering device contained in a television commercial - all designed to kill millions of children. (Movie, Holiday, Horror, Thriller, Mystery) - 1982

amc.ca.title: Halloween 4: The Return of Michael Myers
amc.ca.description: The apparently comatose Michael Myers (George P. Wilbur) is being transferred from one hospital to another, but he wakes up when the ambulance crew talk about his surviving niece, Jamie (Danielle Harris). After slaughtering his attendants, Myers sets out to find his one living relative who is, fortunately, being cared for by a kind and resourceful foster sister named Rachel (Ellie Cornell). Meanwhile, the ever-cautious Dr. Loomis (Donald Pleasence) remains on the killer's path. (Movie, Holiday, Horror) - 1988

amc.ca.title: Halloween 5: The Revenge of Michael Myers
amc.ca.description: After lying in a coma for a year, Michael Myers (Donald L. Shanks) awakens and stalks his way back to his small hometown in Illinois, intent on killing his niece, Jamie (Danielle Harris), who has been confined to a mental institution since Michael's last attempt to slay her. Suspecting a psychic link between Michael and Jamie, psychiatrist Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence) joins forces with Sheriff Ben Meeker (Beau Starr) and attempts to stop Michael's latest rampage. (Movie, Holiday, Horror) - 1989

amc.ca.title: Halloween II
amc.ca.description: After failing to kill stubborn survivor Laurie (Jamie Lee Curtis) and taking a bullet or six from former psychiatrist Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence), Michael Myers (Jonathan Prince) has followed Laurie to the Haddonfield Memorial Hospital, where she's been admitted for Myers' attempt on her life. The institution proves to be particularly suited to serial killers, however, as Myers cuts, stabs and slashes his way through hospital staff to reach his favorite victim. (Movie, Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 1981

amc.ca.title: Halloween
amc.ca.description: On a cold Halloween night in 1963, six-year-old Michael Myers brutally murdered his 17-year-old sister, Judith. He was sentenced and locked away for 15 years. But on October 30, 1978, while being transferred for a court date, a 21-year-old Michael Myers steals a car and escapes Smith's Grove. He returns to his quiet hometown of Haddonfield, Illinois, where he looks for his next victims. (Movie, Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 1978

babytv.ca.description: Bull Lola has a fun and whacky time at the farm as she meets the animals and finds out about life there. The cheerful animals are always happy to have fun and help Lola explore fruits, vegetables, vehicles, foods and more.

babytv.ca.title: Little Lola Visits the Farm
babytv.ca.description: Sheep Lola has a fun and whacky time at the farm as she meets the animals and finds out about life there. The cheerful animals are always happy to have fun and help Lola explore fruits, vegetables, vehicles, foods and more.

babytv.ca.title: Little Lola Visits the Farm
babytv.ca.description: Moo Lola has a fun and whacky time at the farm as she meets the animals and finds out about life there. The cheerful animals are always happy to have fun and help Lola explore fruits, vegetables, vehicles, foods and more.

babytv.ca.title: Snail Trail
babytv.ca.description: Farm Geese Mr Snail meets a farm goose that wants to fly in the sky but cannot.

babytv.ca.title: Snail Trail
babytv.ca.description: Woodpecker Mr Snail meets a wonderful woodpecker. Come along and see woodpecker as he cracks pecan nuts.

babytv.ca.title: Snail Trail
babytv.ca.description: Rooster Mr Snail meets a rooster who has lost his voice. Snail learns to say 'cuckoo'.

babytv.ca.title: Travelers
babytv.ca.description: The Big Apple Harley and Perry go apple picking. They find a huge apple they really want to pick, but they discover there's a cute worm living inside the apple!

babytv.ca.title: Pix & Leo
babytv.ca.description: Midnight Orchestra It's nighttime and the cricket band is playing music! Pix is having trouble sleeping. Will Pix be able to find who is making all that noise?

babytv.ca.title: Mowgli - Welcome to the Jungle
babytv.ca.description: Playin' in the Mud Mowgli, a brave little man-cub, suddenly finds himself alone in the wild jungle. With the help of two loyal wolves and a friendly big bear, he gradually discovers that even the wildest jungle can become a home.

babytv.ca.title: Zeina's Detective Agency
babytv.ca.description: The Puzzled Planter A planter arrives on Zeina's doorstep, and she forgets what it is for. In their search for the answer, Zeina and her best friend Roy discover an original use for the object.

babytv.ca.title: Zeina's Detective Agency
babytv.ca.description: A Pan's Adventure A pan arrives at Zeina's doorstep, forgetting what it is used for. Using her detective skill and her best friend Roy, Zeina discovers that a pan is used for playing tennis... is it?

babytv.ca.title: Zeina's Detective Agency
babytv.ca.description: A Pencil's Curious Quest Zeina receives a pencil, but she has forgotten what you use a pencil for.

babytv.ca.title: Mike's Bike
babytv.ca.description: S01 E03 Bunny and the Cart Bunny is going to sleep over at Petite's house, but she struggles to carry all her toys with her and ride her bike. Mikey has all the answers.

babytv.ca.title: Mike's Bike
babytv.ca.description: S01 E05 Tommy Keeps His Balance Tommy is having a hard time keeping his balance while riding a bike. After trying some of Mike's ideas, he manages to ride with training wheels.

babytv.ca.title: Mike's Bike
babytv.ca.description: S01 E06 Bunny Is Hot Bunny is looking for something to cool her down while she rides her bicycle. Leave it up to Mikey to find a solution.

babytv.ca.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.ca.description: Animal Doctor Mona and Sketch set out to become animal doctors and help fix Butterfly's torn wing.

babytv.ca.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.ca.description: Astronaute Mona and Sketch set out on an adventure to become astronauts. Sketch scribbles stars and a spaceship to travel to space. They use a fan to sprinkle stardust on a star to make it twinkle.

babytv.ca.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.ca.description: Divers Mona and Sketch set out on an adventure to become deep sea divers. Sketch scribbles a diving mask and a boat to sail to sea. The only thing missing is a diving suit.

babytv.ca.title: Billy Bam-Bam
babytv.ca.description: Follow Me Billy and Bam-Bam are tidying up their room together. Join them as they build a tall tower.

babytv.ca.title: Billy Bam-Bam
babytv.ca.description: Happy Holidays Billy and BamBam are excited to see snow and smell gingerbread biscuits. Together, they open up their presents and dress up as Santa, dancing around the tree and having a happy holiday.

babytv.ca.title: Billy Bam-Bam
babytv.ca.description: Hula Hoop Billy and Bam-Bam have fun playing outside on the swing. They discover colourful hula hoops.

babytv.ca.title: Tiny Bunch
babytv.ca.description: Going Camping The entire gang wants to go camping. Will they remember to bring everything they need?

babytv.ca.title: Tiny Bunch
babytv.ca.description: baking a cake Baby helps Rabbit bake a carrot cake with fresh carrots from Rabbit's garden. Baby can't wait until the cake is ready.

babytv.ca.title: Tiny Bunch
babytv.ca.description: Sailing in Hippo's Boat Hippo invites Giraffe and Baby to sail in his boat. Giraffe tries to find excuses not to go.

babytv.ca.title: Bath Tubbies
babytv.ca.description: S02 E01 Bubbles Froggy and Ellie have fun in the bathtub blowing a flower and fish out of soap bubbles, and Ducky wants to join them but must figure out how he is going to reach them.

babytv.ca.title: Bath Tubbies
babytv.ca.description: S01 E01 Splish Splash Froggy is blowing soap bubbles in the bathtub and wants to find out who is spraying water on him, but Ellie is playing ball while Ducky is sleeping on a mattress.

babytv.ca.title: Bath Tubbies
babytv.ca.description: S02 E02 Paint Splashes Ellie and Ducky are having fun playing with paint, but Ellie must clean themselves up in the bath as they cannot go to sleep covered with paint splashes.

babytv.ca.title: Look What I Found
babytv.ca.description: Frog The friends stumble upon a green frog and follow it all the way to a field, where they meet a nice worm and a shy snail.

babytv.ca.title: Look What I Found
babytv.ca.description: Bubble Adventures The friends make bubbles in the water as they go on an underwater adventure inside a bubble. They see fish, jellyfish, a crab, and a friendly juggling octopus.

babytv.ca.title: Look What I Found
babytv.ca.description: Building Blocks A small child enters a room and discovers a household object. This story takes place in the room, but also in the boy's own world. Here, each object transforms into something new, surprising and delightful.

babytv.ca.title: Cuddlies
babytv.ca.description: S01 E13 Train The friends have built a beautiful train and want to hop on board for an exciting ride.

babytv.ca.title: Cuddlies
babytv.ca.description: S02 E01 Flowers Uh-Oh is having lots of fun picking beautiful spring flowers to give to his friends.

babytv.ca.title: Cuddlies
babytv.ca.description: S02 E02 Tall Tickles likes to look at himself in the mirror, but he needs a stool to see because he is short.

skythriller.uk.title: Murder by Numbers (2002)
skythriller.uk.description: A troubled female cop must unravel the perfect murder as she matches wits with two homicidal schoolboys, who believe they can't be caught after committing a motiveless crime. As she gets ever closer to the truth she at once alienates her new partner and puts her own life in peril. (Thriller) - 2002

skythriller.uk.title: Mulholland Drive (2001)
skythriller.uk.description: An actress bonds with an amnesiac in director David Lynch's surreal Hollywood tale. (Mystery / Thriller) - 2001

skythriller.uk.title: Caddo Lake (2024)
skythriller.uk.description: When an 8-year-old girl mysteriously vanishes, a series of past deaths and disappearances start to link together, forever altering a broken family's history. (Mystery / Thriller) - 2024

skythriller.uk.title: Hotel Mumbai (2018)
skythriller.uk.description: Terror strikes in the heart of Mumbai, India, as members of Lashkar-e-Taiba storm the Taj Mahal Palace Hotel in a series of coordinated attacks throughout the city. Amid the gunfire and mayhem, a brave chef and kitchen worker decide to risk their own lives to try and protect the frightened guests. As the militants continue their assault on the hotel, a desperate couple must do whatever they can to protect their newborn baby. (Drama / Thriller) - 2018

skythriller.uk.title: Extremely Wicked, Shockingly Evil and Vile (2019)
skythriller.uk.description: A chronicle of the crimes of Ted Bundy, from the perspective of his longtime girlfriend, who refused to believe the truth about him for years. (Biography / Crime drama) - 2019

skythriller.uk.title: Mr & Mrs Smith (2005)
skythriller.uk.description: John and Jane Smith are a typical suburban couple first seen undergoing marriage counselling to try and get the spark back in their relationship. What neither of them knows is that the other is a highly skilled assassin until, separately, they get a call for their next job. Accidentally double-booked, they discover the truth about each other's secret existence, and are in danger not just from their bosses, but each other. - 2005

skythriller.uk.title: Hungry (2026)
skythriller.uk.description: After becoming lost in the Louisiana swamplands, a group of holidaymakers must fight for their lives against a rampaging hippo on the loose. (Horror / Thriller) - 2026

skythriller.uk.title: Snatch (2000)
skythriller.uk.description: Based on three hybridising narrative strands, three groups of villains are intent on retrieving a missing diamond. Turkish and Tommy team up with a pugilistic Irish gypsy named Mickey for the purpose of rigging unlicensed boxing matches. However, their opponent also arranges some dodgy betting with the courier of the stolen diamond, who subsequently goes missing. To complicate further, a New York gangster arrives on the scene. (Comedy drama) - 2000

skythriller.uk.title: Safe House (2025)
skythriller.uk.description: Six government agents become trapped inside a high-security safe house after a terrorist attack in downtown Los Angeles. They soon realise they must survive not just the enemy outside, but the potential traitor among them. (Action / Thriller) - 2025

skythriller.uk.title: Shaft (2000)
skythriller.uk.description: The famous ex-cop known as Shaft sets out to nail Walter Wade Jnr, a killer using his rich-kid connections to escape conviction, but as Shaft's net draws tighter, he has to contend with killers employed by a desperate Wade. - 2000
